title: Snooze an alert until another date
summary: Remove an alert from the inbox until a date, with the reason.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Snooze
steps.details: Tap the alert's clock. Do it on the alert you want to work on.

steps.title: Until when
steps.details: Use 1 day, 3 days or 1 week, or choose the date. It shows up again that day.
